lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਸਟੁ ਉਠਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi agai kusatee gur ke phitake j os milai tis kusat uthaahee ||
lines.translation: They have already become like lepers; cursed by the Guru, whoever meets them is also afflicted with leprosy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tin kaa darasan naa karahu jo doojai bhaai chit laahee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I pray that I may not even catch sight of those, who focus their consciousness on the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur karatai aap likh paaiaa tis naal kihu chaaraa naahee ||
lines.translation: That which the Creator pre-ordained from the very beginning - there can be no escape from that.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam araadh too tis apaR ko na sakaahee ||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no one can equal it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਵਾਈ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naavai kee vadiaaee vadee hai nit savaaee chaRai chaRaahee ||2||
lines.translation: Great is the greatness of His Name; it increases, day by day. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਹੋਂਦੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: j ho(n)dai guroo bahi tikiaa tis jan kee vadiaaee vadee hoee ||
lines.translation: Great is the greatness of that humble being, whom the Guru Himself anointed in His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kau jagat niviaa sabh pairee paiaa jas varatiaa loee ||
lines.translation: All the world comes and bows to him, falling at his feet. His praises spread throughout the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kau kha(n)d brahama(n)d namasakaar karahi jis kai masatak hath dhariaa gur poorai so pooraa hoee ||
lines.translation: The galaxies and solar systems bow in reverence to him; the Perfect Guru has placed His hand upon his head, and he has become perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee vadiaaee nit chaRai savaaee apaR ko na sakoee ||
lines.translation: The glorious greatness of the Guru increases day by day; no one can equal it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har karatai aap bahi tikiaa aape paij rakhai prabh soee ||3||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Creator Lord Himself established him; God preserves his honor. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kot apaar hai a(n)dar hatanaale ||
lines.translation: The human body is a great fortress, with its shops and streets within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saudaa jo kare har vasat samaale ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh who comes to trade gathers the cargo of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan har vanajeeai heere paravaale ||
lines.translation: He deals in the treasure of the Lord's Name, the jewels and the diamonds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਜਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਧਨੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin kaaiaa j hor thai dhan khojade se mooR betaale ||
lines.translation: Those who search for this treasure outside of the body, in other places, are foolish demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਝਾੜ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: se ujhaR bharam bhavaaeeahi jiu jhaaR mirag bhaale ||15||
lines.translation: They wander around in the wilderness of doubt, like the deer who searches for the musk in the bushes. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ni(n)daa kare satigur poore kee s aukhaa jag mahi hoiaa ||
lines.translation: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall have difficulty in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਖੂਹੁ ਹੈ ਓਥੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਓਹੁ ਢੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: narak ghor dukh khoohu hai othai pakaR ohu dhoiaa ||
lines.translation: He is caught and thrown into the most horrible hell, the well of pain and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kook pukaar ko na sune ohu aukhaa hoi hoi roiaa ||
lines.translation: No one listens to his shrieks and cries; he cries out in pain and misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: on halat palat sabh gavaaiaa laahaa mool sabh khoiaa ||
lines.translation: He totally loses this world and the next; he has lost all of his investment and profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਤੇਲੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਲਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu telee sa(n)daa balad kar nit bhalake uth prabh joiaa ||
lines.translation: He is like the ox at the oil-press; each morning when he rises, God places the yoke upon him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har vekhai sunai nit sabh kichh tidoo kichh gujhaa na hoiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord always sees and hears everything; nothing can be concealed from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਬੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beeje so lunai jehaa purab kinai boiaa ||
lines.translation: As you plant, so shall you harvest, according to what you planted in the past.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kripaa kare prabh aapanee tis satigur ke charan dhoiaa ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by God's Grace washes the feet of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਕਾਠ ਸੰਗੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur pichhai tar gaiaa jiu lohaa kaath sa(n)goiaa ||
lines.translation: He is carried across by the Guru, the True Guru, like iron which is carried across by wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaai too jap har har naam sukh hoiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, peace is obtained. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaageeaa sohaaganee jinaa guramukh miliaa har raai ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate is the soul-bride, who, as Gurmukh, meets the Lord, her King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jot pragaaseeaa naanak naam samaai ||2||
lines.translation: Her inner being is illiminated with His Divine Light; O Nanak, she is absorbed in His Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu sareer sabh dharam hai jis a(n)dar sache kee vich jot ||
lines.translation: This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਰਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਢੈ ਖੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guhaj ratan vich luk rahe koee guramukh sevak kadhai khot ||
lines.translation: Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selfless servant, who digs them out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਇਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa taa(n) ik raviaa iko ot pot ||
lines.translation: When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lord permeating, through and through.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik dekhiaa ik ma(n)niaa iko suniaa sravan sarot ||
lines.translation: He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One.
